title: relay_queue.rs enqueue comment mis-states crash behavior for .msg-without-.env
description: relay_queue.rs enqueue doc comment (lines 115-120) states: 'Crash between the two renames: .msg exists, .env does not. The drain skips this .msg (no .env partner) and the file is retried on the next startup scan.' The drain does not scan .msg files — it only scans .env files. The comment incorrectly describes the crash recovery behavior. This is the same issue as the orphan-.msg bug (stoa-5be7a2c5.2) but distinct as a documentation problem: even after the bug is fixed, the comment would need to accurately describe what happens.
